what: Design readiness deadlock: the design's consolidated spec change (scr_01M56E0GBWEPD25ZHEGXQYZ6XM) added R6.1, R7.1 and R8.20, design criteria of kind human, as ordinary criteria; designReadiness (design/approval.ts ~1018) requires every added criterion covered by a check of the effective version (stricter than D7 §7.5); the Verifier rightly wrote no check for human-judged criteria and deferred them to stage 4 (prerequisite), which is itself held design_pending: the design stays approved with ready_at null, stages 3 and 4 held, nothing in flight and no question naming the cause (design_due offers only open/waive/policy_off/later). Observed 03:17 UTC, stalled since 02:44.

The rerun of m6w_design (SURETY_REAL_RERUN=m6w_design at 292e11e, 06:38 UTC) was refused before any engine started: the harness's leftovers check (checks-journey.mjs leftovers/refuseLeftovers, evenIfPaused because the step resumes the project) counted stage 3 and stage 4's stage_build items (wi_01M56CC1ZRBKYD2HMNXY0G286C, wi_01M56CC1ZSESC8WJN99KVPM0KW; eligible, no run ever) as work of an earlier attempt that could be dispatched. They are held by the engine's computed design_pending blocker, which leftovers() does not read (it reads only dispatch_hold and the chain limit), so its own stated rule ('an eligible item not held') is not what it checks. Their release is the design step's own purpose. A harness defect of the M6 lane; no tokens spent.

After the rerun of m6w_design passed (07:00 UTC), judge (c) halted the run: 'the combined approval is in the per-act record'. recordActs on a rerun reads storeActs from the rerun's own start (sinceSeq = maxSeq at the rerun, step-starts.json overwritten to 06:56:45) and replaces the step's acts, so the first attempt's acts of the same step (design_due open 02:18, correction approvals, finding dispositions, designer_feedback, preview_inspection 02:38, combined_approval 02:39, all in the store and in driver-acts.jsonl) are absent from acts-M519.json; only qualify_adapter and preview_inspection of the rerun are recorded. A harness defect of the M6 lane's rerun; no tokens spent by it.

Confirming the review's design_verdicts (3 labs, deltas) filed 23 findings (one per implementation delta and lab), each linked to criterion R8.19 and check design-asset-favicon, whatever the delta concerns (the start-up card, input-error wording, the Run button label, the scene grid, the skip link, scene markers, a hint). Their finding_disposition 'fix' would hold the gates only until design-asset-favicon passes, a check unrelated to the defect that already passes, so a fix would be resolved by unrelated evidence; correct_check would name the same unrelated check. Also the design-kind recommendations marked 'both' were filed as implementation defects. The driver answered accept on all 23 (recorded, no gate hold); the defects stay recorded for a later run.
